target: projects/q-explorer-prototype/index.html — Q-Explorer (QMS RPV CH) · Round 2: read a finished report
primary_task: An analyst opens a finished evaluation, reads the quality figures, breaks them down, checks a chart, drills into the raw data and exports.
recon_method: real Chromium (Playwright, /usr/bin/chromium-browser), DE and EN, opened via the real 'Anzeigen' buttons

not_exercised.reason: no such views exist — those evaluation types have no 'Anzeigen' action, so there is nothing to open
reached only indirectly; chart interactions were exercised in the V11 popup instead
structurally the same as view-raw-punct, which was exercised in full

controls.label: Header
controls.observed: title 'Anschlusspünktlichkeit – Letzte 30 Tage'; NO subtitle and NO generation timestamp (page-subtitle is null on V5, V8 and V11 alike)

controls.label: Param chips
controls.observed: date_range 01.04.2026 – 30.04.2026 · Mon – Sun · RPV + OV · Concession · 15 TU's ▾ · 8 Kantone ▾ · 42 Linien ▾

controls.label: Expandable param chip (TU's / Kantone / Linien)
controls.observed: expands to a read-only list (AAGL, AAGR, AB, …), collapses on a second click. Items have no onclick and cursor:auto — the chips look like editable filters but nothing in the report can be changed, and there is no Apply. The dropdown header reads 'Transport companies' in English while the whole page is German.

controls.label: KPI cards
controls.observed: 4 cards with thresholds: All day 89,53% ⚠ / HVZ morning 90,41% ✓ / HVZ evening 86,44% ⚠ / Last trip 88,87% ⚠, each labelled 'Threshold: 90%' — clear and useful

controls.label: Aufschlüsseln nach — 3 selects
controls.observed: DEAD CONTROL: options are Line bundle/TU/Stop/Transport mode/Line (connector)/Line (feeder)/Operating day/CW. Selecting TU, then Line, leaves the table byte-identical — 30 rows, same Total row, same first column. The primary analysis control of the report does nothing.

controls.label: CSV Export
controls.observed: shows a snackbar 'Preparing CSV export…'

controls.label: KPI cards
controls.observed: 3 cards: Trips 953'278 / 33'483 cancelled / rate 3.51%; Journey time; Stops — with rate colouring

controls.label: CSV Export
controls.observed: the button has NO onclick attribute at all. Clicking it produces no snackbar, no toast, no download, nothing — while the identical-looking button on V5 and V11 does respond.

controls.label: Ausfallmaske request (fact_check icon per row)
controls.observed: works: the icon is replaced by a check_circle and a 'Data sheet' / 'Info sheet' link appears, then the Ausfallmaske view opens with 10 rows

controls.label: Treemap overview
controls.observed: #fa-mask-treemap is a DIV-based treemap with 5 children (not SVG) — renders fine

controls.label: Params header
controls.observed: uses the bordered field-column style (.fa-mask-header), not the chips used on V5/V8/V11 — the documented intentional split between summary and raw views

controls.label: Table
controls.observed: 12+ columns (Operating day, TU, GO No., Line bundle, Line, Trip ID, Trip TU, From stop, Cancelled from, To stop, Cancelled until, No. stops), 10 rows via the real path

controls.label: KPI cards
controls.observed: ZERO KPI cards on V11, while V5 has 4 and V8 has 3. The report opens straight into the breakdown selects and the table.

controls.label: Table numbers
controls.observed: ARITHMETIC HOLDS: Total row Soll 2.101.488, Ist 2.048.996, pünktlich 1.861.401, Delta 52.492 = Soll − Ist exactly, Wert 90,84% = pünktlich/Ist. Spot-checked 5 bundle rows (e.g. AAGL BusÜ 1: 14.048/13.954/13.106, Delta 94, 93,92%) — every one consistent.

controls.label: Aufschlüsseln — 3 cascading selects
controls.observed: DEAD CONTROL: level 1 changed from Linienbündel → Haltestelle → TU konzessioniert leaves the table byte-identical (20 rows, first column header stays 'Name / Line bundle', same first row). Setting all three levels changes nothing either. The cascade's option-disabling logic does work (Linienbündel becomes disabled in level 2).

controls.label: Bundle row expander (caret)
controls.observed: FIRST CLICK DOES NOTHING. Reproduced 4× from a fresh load: initial 20 rows → 1st click 20 rows (no change) → 2nd click 26 rows (6 line rows appear) → 3rd click 20 again. Cause: the button ships without the .collapsed class while the line rows ship hidden, so the first click re-hides already-hidden rows. The caret icon also never changes — it reads 'expand_more' whether expanded or collapsed.

controls.label: Schließen button
controls.observed: present on V11 and on the raw view, absent on V5, V8 and V10

controls.label: CSV Export
controls.observed: snackbar 'Preparing CSV export…'

controls.label: Chart popup
controls.observed: opens as an overlay; toolbar = Snapshot, zoom +, zoom −, fullscreen, home/reset, close. Zoom works (svg width 1044 → 1566) and reset restores it.

controls.label: Snapshot button
controls.observed: no onclick attribute; clicking it after clearing the snackbar produces NO feedback at all

controls.label: Fullscreen button
controls.observed: no onclick attribute — dead

controls.label: Escape key / focus
controls.observed: Escape does NOT close the chart modal (only × or a click outside). Focus is not moved into the modal and not trapped: two Tab presses land on a background button outside the overlay.

controls.label: Paginator
controls.observed: works: 'First Previous 1 2 … 495 Next Last', 10 rows per page of 4950, info line updates '1 to 10' → '11 to 20', rows genuinely change

controls.label: Column search inputs (16) and column selects (2)
controls.observed: ALL DEAD: every one of the 16 inputs has no oninput/onchange/onkeyup attribute, and both selects have no onchange. Typing a no-match value ('ZZZZ') and typing a real value ('10.06.2026') followed by Enter both leave the row count at 10 and the info line unchanged at 'of 4950 entries'. 18 controls that look like filters and filter nothing.

controls.label: Sidebar active state inside a report
controls.observed: no .nav-item is active while a report is open — the sidebar shows no location at all

controls.label: Back / close affordances
controls.observed: all six report/detail views have a breadcrumb and a route back to the list, but a 'Schließen' button exists only on V11 and view-raw-punct

controls.label: Language switching
controls.observed: switched EN → DE → EN twice from inside the Pünktlichkeit report. Most of the UI does translate correctly (nav 'Evaluations'/'Auswertungen', table head 'Name / Line bundle'/'Name / Linienbündel', button 'Close'/'Schließen'). What does NOT translate: 12 options across the three Aufschlüsseln selects stay German in EN mode ('Linienbündel', 'Haltestelle', 'Monat', 'TU konzessioniert', 'TU fahrend') — the count is identical (12) in both languages. Separately, in DE mode the expandable chip dropdown header reads 'Transport companies' in English.
